LESSON: READING 11.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: LESSONS LEARNT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What issues in the society are addressed by stories?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story
2. appreciate the role of stories in addressing societal issues

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 11.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: LESSONS LEARNT
This lesson teaches Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the role of stories in addressing societal issues
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt above.
2. Explain Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What issues in the society are addressed by stories?
2. How can one derive lessons from a short story?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the lessons learnt in a short story
2. appreciate the role of stories in addressing societal issues

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
